name: framepack
description: A lightweight HyperFrames creative workbench for assets, prompts, composition, and iteration.
readme:
# Framepack

Framepack is a programmatic video workbench for coding agents (Codex, Claude Code) and the HyperFrames render runtime. It turns rough user ideas, assets, references, and fuzzy taste words into a professional video plan.

Programmatic video (Framepack) vs Generative video (Runway/Sora): Framepack orchestrates existing assets with HTML/CSS/GSAP animations — no pixels are generated, only composed. Generative AI creates new imagery from text prompts.

中文: Framepack 是程式化视频工作台。它把模糊的用户需求翻译成设计系统、视觉令牌、HTML 骨架、素材说明、composition 方案和迭代记忆。不生成画面，只编排画面。

Quick start:

```bash
npm install framepack
npx framepack create --idea "A premium launch video" --assets ./assets --output-dir ./out --project-name launch-video
npx framepack workbench brief --project-dir ./out/launch-video
npx framepack catalog install   # batch-install Catalog components
```

Create from a reference video's DNA:

```bash
npx framepack create --dna ./VIDEO_DNA.md --assets ./assets --output-dir ./out --project-name my-video
```

Commands: create, lint, preview, render, catalog install, workbench brief, templates prompt.

Full docs: https://github.com/ARTHUR-BBU/framepack
